title: osquery host posture snapshot
description: One endpoint's posture as reported by osquery / Fleet. v1.1 adds last_seen_at (the host's own last check-in, which observed_at is not) and reason (why the result is inconclusive). A posture boolean is present only when the connector read it: false means observed off, and an absent key means not read. Fleet's Get host API has no firewall or screen-lock field, so a Fleet-sourced record omits both.

disk_encryption_enabled.description: Absent when the source did not report it. Fleet omits it when it does not know the status, and for Linux hosts reporting an unencrypted root volume.

screen_lock_enabled.description: Absent when the source did not report it. Never present on a Fleet-sourced record.

firewall_enabled.description: Absent when the source did not report it. Never present on a Fleet-sourced record.

mdm_enrolled.description: From Fleet's mdm.enrollment_status: true for "On (...)", false for "Off" or "Pending", absent otherwise.

last_seen_at.description: When the host last checked in (Fleet's seen_time). The record's observed_at is when the connector pulled, and Fleet lists offline hosts too.

reason.description: Why the result is what it is, e.g. which posture fields were not reported, or the Fleet error from the detail fetch.
